name: Edit a Short
about: You have footage for one vertical Short (9:16). Like Edit a video, at 1080x1920, with captions in the Shorts style.

card.bring: A recording for a vertical video (9:16).
card.you: Tell the agent what you want, watch the rough cut and keep or restore its cuts, approve, check the final, export.
card.agent: Cuts the rough, adds captions and visuals in 9:16, then checks its own work.

start.hint: Next: drop your recording into the media bin, then press Go.

withFootage.hint: Next: your footage is going in. When it is there, press Go and the agent asks what you want from the Short.

stages.title: Brief
stages.focus: This is a Short (1080x1920, usually under 60 s). Ask about the hook, the length, and what the viewer must take away.

stages.title: Rough cut
stages.focus: Make the 9:16 rough: transcribe, scan, write video/out/edl.json (1080x1920; reframe the source with faces.py reframe, or a SPLIT of screen and cam), joins.py check and snap, build_rough.py, handover.py. A Short is tight: the hook in the first two seconds, no dead air. Heavy steps run in the background.

stages.title: Rough review
stages.focus: The user watches the rough Short and goes through its cuts. Approve & lock fixes the talk.

stages.title: Visuals
stages.focus: Dress the locked rough with Events.for_cut(cut, "short"): word captions (shortcaps.py), the hook text, labels from the Shorts kit, punch-ins; text inside the safe zone. run.py --proof, then run.py --final in the background.

stages.title: Inspect
stages.focus: check_cut.py, the contact sheet, captions against the words, every text inside the Shorts safe zone, the hook in the first two seconds.

stages.title: Final review
stages.focus: The user watches the Short. Sending it back goes to Visuals.

stages.title: Export
stages.focus: MP4 and SRT from the Export tab.
